reviews.text: Cilene was very careful and caring with my kittens, and she was also responsible. I recommend her work!!

This was my first time using a pet sitter's service, and I met Cilene through Instagram. I hired her services for Carnival 2026 and traveled without worry. She is very kind and caring; my cats were very well taken care of, pampered, and looked after. I received videos and photos after each visit. When I returned, the area where the litter boxes are kept was clean and organized, and she also observed and resolved any potential traps the cats might set up while alone. On the last day, she even left a toy as a gift for them and a small treat for me. I am so grateful for someone trustworthy who does her job responsibly and with love. Thank you, Cilene, I highly recommend her.

Excellent service. From the first contact, they were super helpful and communicated clearly and quickly. They responded promptly and showed great care for the animals. I returned from my trip and my cats were fine and very well cared for! Thank you 🥰 …

Aunt Cilene is the only professional I trust to care for my kitten completely! Loving, attentive, and always alert to everything. I am so grateful to have her in our lives and for everything she does for us! ♥️

Cilene is an exceptional pet sitter! Very careful, responsible, and loving with pets. From the beginning, she showed attention to every detail of the routine and always kept us informed, sending updates that made us feel calm and confident. It was clear how much love and dedication she puts into everything. We are very grateful for her care and certainly recommend her work!
Cilene takes very good care of my cats whenever I need to travel, and has been doing so for almost two years. I highly recommend her!

Oh Aunt Ci... besides all the affection and love she has for animals, she understands their world, and she's also super responsible... my four-legged girls adore her, she's been walking and taking care of them for some time now... I can only be grateful.

If you want a professional who truly loves animals, Cilene is the best choice. You can feel the love she has for and the care she gives to your pet children. You would only entrust them to the best. I recommend her without hesitation. 😍 …
Aunt Cilene is an excellent professional. Committed, passionate about what she does, and she cares for your pet with the utmost affection. Plus, she gives excellent advice.

I leave my 3 cats in Aunt Cilene's care with complete peace of mind. She is very responsible, careful, and has a great love for her profession. I travel with peace of mind, knowing they are well taken care of.
Cilene is great with pets. Attentive, caring, and super responsible. I've been a client for a while now, and my cats adore her!
Aunt Cilene is great, my little ones adore her.

Aunt Cilene is wonderful! I needed to be away for a week and she took care of my 3 cats with so much love. She brought them toys, played with them, organized their things, and established a routine. They were super calm and got used to her quickly. Every day, as soon as I got home, Aunt Cilene would send me photos and videos of my little ones.

I'm a big fan of Aunt Cilene and whenever I need to be away, she'll take care of my little ones.

Thank you for the love and care ❤️❤️❤️
Thank you 😊 …

I received exceptional service! My puppy, who is only 3 months old, was very well received, and we received valuable advice on how to help him adapt to apartment living, as well as guidance on behavior and tips for safe walks. The service is always prompt and demonstrates a deep understanding of animal care. I am extremely satisfied!
Cilene is great. She truly loves animals. She took very good care of my cats and my plants. I trust her completely. I recommend her.

I couldn't be happier with Aunt Cilene's services taking care of my cats when I'm away! She's simply amazing and deserves all the recognition for her exceptional care!
From the first contact, her professionalism and dedication were evident.
One characteristic that caught my attention is her constant vigilance. She is always alert to any sign of discomfort or need on the part of the animals. This reassures me during my travels, knowing that my cats are under the care of someone so attentive.
Another positive point is the special touch she adds to the service. In addition to fulfilling her responsibilities, Aunt Cilene also planted grass for my cats, providing an enriched and stimulating environment for them. It is evident that she cares about the well-being of the animals and goes above and beyond to ensure they are happy. :)
I highly recommend Aunt Cilene's services. My gratitude for making my travels more peaceful and ensuring that my cats receive all the love and attention they deserve.
Very careful and loving with our pets! I recommend her!!

Cilene is very responsible and kind. I have a rather timid kitten who doesn't accept affection from strangers. Cilene helped him adapt, and he accepted and enjoyed her presence. I am very grateful for her work. You can trust her!
I highly recommend her. Attentive, loving, with extensive technical knowledge and a passion for what she does.
